audit.whatIsWrong: Lane-difficulty prose repeatedly told you to "bait Lilac Vault" and called her ultimate a root.
audit.why: Lillia has no ability called Lilac Vault. Her ultimate is Lilting Lullaby (R, 150/130/110s) and it is not a root: it makes every enemy carrying Dream Dust Drowsy, then asleep, and they take extra damage when woken. Playing around a root is not the same as playing around a sleep you will be woken out of.
audit.corrected: Fabricated name killed in spikes[1], wants.foe[1], whys[4], mid and late; the real sleep-and-wake mechanic is now stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike named a non-existent ability; the late spike gave no ultimate cooldown.
audit.why: Lilting Lullaby is 150s at rank 1 and 110s at rank 3 — a huge early window that shrinks a lot by late game, which changes how freely you can force fights across the game.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] and late now carry the real name and the 150s/110s numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: The kit interaction that actually beats your build was absent: the outer edge of Blooming Blows deals TRUE damage.
audit.why: Riot's text for Blooming Blows: "dealing extra true damage on the edge". Stacking armour is the wrong answer to her spin, and the 6s rank-1 cooldown sets the rhythm of her kite.
audit.corrected: early now names the 6s cooldown and states the edge true damage.

edits.before: World Ender's heal amp lets you win the extended trade her passive Dream Dust is trying to bleed you out of, but she can R to root and disengage, so bait Lilac Vault first.
edits.after: World Ender's heal amp wins the extended trade her Dream Dust is trying to bleed you out of, but Lilting Lullaby (R) puts you to sleep and wakes you for bonus damage — bait it first.

edits.before: Root you with R Lilac Vault to escape or set up a gank
edits.after: Sleep you with Lilting Lullaby to escape or set up a gank

edits.before: Skill at 6 — she can R Lilac Vault to root and disengage every time you commit.
edits.after: Skill at 6 — Lilting Lullaby (R) puts you to sleep every time you commit.

edits.before: Level 3 is your peak and the win[] tips firmly to you: with Q's three casts plus E Umbral Dash you can finally catch her, and landing the Q3 sweetspot knockup into your drain shreds her before Dream Dust can bleed you out. Levels 4-5 stay yours as repeated all-ins beat her fragile early scaling. It only levels to Skill at 6, where she can R Lilac Vault to root-and-run whenever you commit, so bait it or have her flash down. Force the fight in melee where her poke can't kite you.
edits.after: Level 3 is your peak and the win[] tips firmly to you: with Q's three casts plus E Umbral Dash you can finally catch her, and landing the Q3 sweetspot knockup into your drain shreds her before Dream Dust can bleed you out. Levels 4-5 stay yours as repeated all-ins beat her fragile early scaling. It only levels to Skill at 6, where Lilting Lullaby (R) makes you Drowsy and then asleep whenever you commit — and waking you costs extra damage. Bait it or catch her with it down.

edits.before: After your first item you spike again and out-brawl her one-on-one, so pressure the sidelane and deny her free scaling. But the last phase belongs to Lillia: with Liandry's and Rylai's she becomes an unkillable-feeling kiter who out-DPSes your drain from range and brings a global root ult to fights, so avoid chasing her through minions and let your team eat the frontline for you.
edits.after: After your first item you spike again and out-brawl her one-on-one, so pressure the sidelane and deny her free scaling. But the last phase belongs to Lillia: with Liandry's and Rylai's she becomes an unkillable-feeling kiter who out-DPSes your drain from range, and Lilting Lullaby is a 150s at rank 1 but only 110s maxed — check it before every fight and let your team eat the frontline.

edits.before: You hold the edge from level 1: Lillia's Blooming Blows (Q) out-ranges your melee auto and stacks Dream Dust movespeed to kite, but she has no hard commit and can't kill you, while your base stats and passive heal let you win any short trade she walks into. Soak minimal Dream Dust ticks, farm safely, and set up your level 3 spike where your gap-close comes fully online. Deny her free chip and don't chase her spin past your minions.
edits.after: You hold the edge from level 1: Blooming Blows (Q) is a 6s spin that out-ranges your melee auto and stacks Move Speed to kite, and its outer edge adds true damage that your armour does nothing about — but she has no hard commit and can't kill you, while your base stats and passive heal win any short trade. Soak minimal Dream Dust ticks, farm safely, and set up your level 3 spike. Don't chase her spin past your minions.

notes: CORRECTION OF RECORD: "Lilac Vault" is a fabricated ability name — Lillia's R is Lilting Lullaby. Aatrox's Infernal Chains (W) carries a derived "grounding" flag that Riot's description does not support (drag + slow only), so no grounding claim was made in this slice.
